[BTS 27 002(fashion)] New / Slide10.JPG: Cotton is a plant that grows in warm, sunny climates. It is used to make many different clothes. Many T-shirts, sweatshirts and socks are made of cotton.
Cotton clothes can be casual and cheap or fancy and expensive. Cotton is also used to make cotton swabs, which you use to clean your ears.
[BTS 27 002(fashion)] New / Slide11.JPG: Denim is made of cotton, but it is made in a special way. The most common use of denim is in jeans. It is also used for skirts and bags. In the past, denim jackets were very fashionable.
Many denim clothes are blue. However, denim can be any color. In the 1980s, green, orange and purple jeans were popular!
[BTS 27 002(fashion)] New / Slide12.JPG: Wool comes from sheep. Every year, farmers shear their sheep's hair to make wool. People have worn wool clothes for thousands of years.
Wool is popular because it is very warm. Sweaters, scarves and some socks are made of wool. But some people think it feels scratchy.
[BTS 27 002(fashion)] New / Slide13.JPG: Like wool, leather is thousands of years old. It is made of animal skins. Cow skin and sheep skin are used most often.
Many people like leather jackets, bags, hats and belts. Leather looks nice, but it is usually expensive!
[BTS 27 002(fashion)] New / Slide14.JPG: Plastic has many uses. Many of our clothes are made from plastic because it is cheap and it lasts a long time. Sometimes plastic and cotton are mixed together in a shirt.
Rain jackets and sports clothes are usually made of plastic because they dry very fast. Many cheap clothes that look like leather are really made of plastic!
[BTS 27 002(fashion)] New / Slide15.JPG: Silk fabric is very expensive. This is because it is made by caterpillars called silkworms. They make the silk when they change into moths!
Silk was invented in ancient China. At that time, it was so expensive that only kings and queens could wear it. Today, silk is used in expensive blankets, suits and dresses.

Stripes are very common in clothes all over the world. Both men and women wear striped clothing.
Stripes can be many colors and can go in different directions. Some years, stripes are very popular. Other years, they are not. They often go in and out of style.
Polka dots have been popular for about 100 years. They are small, colored dots on a piece of clothing. All kinds of clothes can have polka dots. Toys and furniture can have them, too.
Polka dots are often worn by women and small children. Many people think they look cute, but they are very rare on fancy clothes.
Plaid comes from Scotland in the United Kingdom. It has different-colored stripes. The stripes cross each other and make squares.
Plaid is popular on scarves, shirts, skirts and socks. In Scotland, even men wear plaid skirts! They call them kilts.
Animal patterns are very popular on clothes. The leopard pattern is especially popular. You can also see tiger and zebra patterns on clothes.
Many shirts, dresses and scarves use these patterns. Many people think they look interesting and exciting.
Polka dots are very common on fancy clothes.

Clothes go in and out of style over time. This happens again and again. Some people say style changes like the seasons.
Tight, skinny jeans were popular in the 1970s and 1980s. Loose, baggy jeans became popular in the 1990s.
A fad is a new style that comes fast. It is very popular for a short time. Then it goes out of style, and people forget about it. Clothes, toys or even foods can become fads.
Parachute pants were popular in the 1980s. By the 1990s, they were out of style, and people made fun of them.
A trend lasts longer than a fad. It is popular for a long time. People follow different trends depending on their lifestyle.
Roller skates were invented a long time ago, in the 1800s. Later, inline skates came out. Skating became popular around the world, and it is still popular today.

The Pet Rock was invented in 1974 by Gary Dahl. He heard his friends complaining about their pets, so he made a pet that needed no care!
People thought it was cute and clever. It sold very well at Christmas in 1975. Then it quickly went out of style, but Mr. Dahl became a millionaire!
Pokémon was made by Satoshi Tajiri in Japan in 1996. As a kid, his hobby was collecting insects. That gave him the idea.
It started as a video game. Then came TV shows, movies and a card game. People thought it would go out of style, but it hasn't yet!
The Snuggie was invented in 2008. Its creators wanted it to be a wearable blanket.
The Snuggie appeared on many websites and TV shows. Some people even had Snuggie parties! It sold very well on TV home shopping at Christmas in 2009.
Barbie dolls first appeared in the USA in 1959. Ruth Handler watched her daughter play with paper dolls. She got the idea to make a doll of a grown-up woman. At that time, most dolls were babies.
Barbie has been popular around the world for more than 60 years. There are even Barbie books, games and a song!
